cards.title: Where statuses come from
cards.text: Base attacks go plain; statuses come from abilities and trinkets. Mark what's off.
cards.why: This changes what each hero does today. My guess at which ability gives what is in the parts.
cards.pick: Build it as written in stage 4. Enemies built around statuses come later, as a board of my pitches.

parts.title: Plain base attacks
parts.text: Archer arrows no longer chill. Rogue pokes no longer poison. Knight swings stay plain.

parts.title: From abilities
parts.text: Archer Barrage: fire. Rogue Shadow Step: poison. Knight Charge: stagger. More come from skill-tree abilities.

parts.title: From trinkets
parts.text: Frost, Ember and Venom rings as now, plus a ring for each new status. Frost only comes from trinkets for now.

parts.title: Burn spreads
parts.text: A burning unit can pass 20-50% of its burn to those touching it.

parts.title: Chill
parts.text: A flat slow while chilled, no ramp. Freeze and shatter as now; shatter is a heavy hit, never an instant kill.

parts.title: Poison
parts.text: Also slightly slows attacks and movement while it lasts.

parts.title: Wet
parts.text: Abilities come round slower. At 100 the unit slips: spins for a second and leaves a puddle. Doubles shock, halves burn.

parts.title: Shock
parts.text: A short stun that strikes again every few moments while it lasts.

parts.title: Stagger
parts.text: A short stun that stacks. At 100: knocked out for a few seconds, takes extra damage.
